Under map 2.0.0 it went red too when the map's assertedBy word for the players was not the engine's (`TieDecider.Players => "the players"`), when the map's assertedBy for initiative-ties was narrowed to ["GM"], and when the GM decided only all-monster ties. Under map 1.0.0 it went red under the dropped-modifier, reverse-draw-order and d19 mutations above, and under the ascending-order and tie-breaks-ignored mutations of initiative-order.
